claims.claimText: IJAPS, a Penerbit Universiti Sains Malaysia journal, requires manuscript authors to note AI software use such as ChatGPT in Materials and Methods or Acknowledgments and not list AI as an author.
claims.claimValue: IJAPS requires AI-use disclosure and prohibits AI authorship

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Use of artificial intelligence (AI) software, such as ChatGPT, must be noted in the Materials and Methods section (or Acknowledgments, if no Materials and Methods section is available) of the manuscript and may not be listed as an author.

claims.claimText: IJAPS states that generative AI and AI-assisted technologies used in scientific writing should only improve readability and language, with human oversight, careful review, and author accountability.
claims.claimValue: IJAPS limits GenAI writing assistance to readability and language improvement

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Where authors use generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process, these technologies should only be used to improve readability and language of the work.
evidence.snippetLocation: The Use of Generative AI and AI-assisted Technologies in Scientific Writing section

claims.claimText: Kajian Malaysia, a Penerbit Universiti Sains Malaysia journal, allows AI-assisted tools for language improvement but keeps authors fully responsible for the quality and accuracy of the final text.
claims.claimValue: Kajian Malaysia allows AI language assistance with author responsibility

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The use of AI-assisted tools for language improvement is allowed, but authors are fully responsible for the quality and accuracy of the final text.

claims.claimText: The CDAE-hosted guideline says students should use GenAI prudently and ethically under the guidelines set by their higher education provider, while supporting rather than taking over their role as students.
claims.claimValue: students should use GenAI ethically and not let it replace their role

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Menggunakan KBG secara berhemah dan beretika berdasarkan garis panduan yang telah ditetapkan oleh PPT.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Students should use GenAI prudently and ethically based on guidelines set by the higher education provider.
